about: What a viewer accepts from a host, from src/renderer/viewer/validate.js: signaling relayed from the host and control data-channel messages. null = ignore the message. limits: maxima the module enforces (lengths in UTF-16 units), measured by probing it; the cases stay below them. Regenerate with node scripts/make-mobile-fixtures.js.

sanitizeSdp.about: sanitizeSdp(sdp, isAllowedCandidate): drops every a=candidate line whose address is not a Tailscale IP; lines are joined with CRLF. A non-string gives "".

validateControl.about: validateControl(msg) -> the clean control-channel message from the host, or null. Types a viewer only sends (select-display, quality) and unknown types -> null.

cases.note: unusable entries are skipped; default names count the kept ones
a part that is present must be valid

validateSignal.about: validateSignal(msg) -> the clean message or null. The viewer is always the answerer: only offers are accepted. Shapes only; addresses are filtered by isAllowedCandidate.
